note: LIVE config. These 8 ids are the ones OpenCode Zen answers as free right now (GET /zen/v1/models, filtered by -free): the catalog on models.dev can lag behind, so the CI step checks this list against the live one before a sweep. harness=opencode runs the real CLI headless and grades the file it writes. 8 * 5 tasks * 2 variants * 3 reps = 240 agent runs.

variants.vanilla: You are an expert Python developer. Solve the task exactly as specified.
variants.minimal: You write the least Python that fully satisfies the spec. Standard library only. No classes, no abstractions, no comments, no error handling beyond what the spec requires, no extra features. A few clear lines beat a clever framework.
